MIRA schema — vendored copy (pinned)
=====================================

The overlay (../mira_x.yaml) imports `vendor/mira`, which pulls the full MIRA import
closure. These files are VENDORED (copied) rather than fetched at build time because
MIRA's imports (prov, schemaorg, discoursegraphs_base -> sioc -> dct) are LOCAL YAML
files in the MIRA repo, not upstream LinkML packages. They are NOT committed to this
repo by default — run `make vendor` (../Makefile) to populate this directory.

Pinned source
-------------
repo:   https://github.com/MIRA-science/schema
branch: main
commit: f7d0449a34efe776e4ca69a350ebaa8fa60fcc19      # verified 2026-06-09
        (proposals branch SHA 083dae81c7dd810258954cf5946563222d5069a9 is the
         reference for the funder-side classes mirrored into ../mira_x.yaml)

Files to vendor (the import closure of mira.yaml)
-------------------------------------------------
  mira.yaml
  discoursegraphs_base.yaml
  sioc.yaml
  dct.yaml
  prov.yaml
  schemaorg.yaml
  # discoursegraphs.yaml         # optional (parallel discourse-graph schema; not imported by us)

Fetch command (also done by `make vendor`)
-------------------------------------------
  SHA=f7d0449a34efe776e4ca69a350ebaa8fa60fcc19
  BASE=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MIRA-science/schema/$SHA
  for f in mira discoursegraphs_base sioc dct prov schemaorg; do
    curl -fsSL "$BASE/$f.yaml" -o "$f.yaml"
  done

Notes
-----
- To bump the pin: change SHA here + in ../Makefile + in ../../.env.example
  (MIRA_SCHEMA_SHA), re-run `make vendor schema`, and review the deltas.
- Do NOT hand-edit vendored files. All local changes/additions belong in ../mira_x.yaml
  (that diff IS the upstream proposal — SPEC §17).
